## Theme

```{r}
scale_factor = 2.5
vivax_theme <- function() {
  theme_bw() +
    
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = scale_factor * 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = scale_factor * 13),
          
          plot.title = element_markdown(face = "bold",
                                        size = scale_factor * 16,
                                        hjust = 0,
                                        margin = margin(b = 2)),
          
          plot.subtitle = element_markdown(face="italic",
                                           size = scale_factor * 12,
                                           lineheight=0.4,
                                           margin = margin(b = 0.5)),
          # RIGHT TEXT (Caption)
          plot.caption.position = "plot",
          plot.caption = element_markdown(face = "italic",
                                          hjust = 1, # Flush right
                                          vjust = 0, # Anchored to the bottom
                                          size = scale_factor * 8,
                                          lineheight = 0.4,
                                          # t=15 pushes the chart up to make room. 
                                          # b=0 forces it to sit exactly on the bottom plot margin.
                                          margin = margin(t = 3, b = 0, r = 5, unit = "pt")),
          
          # LEFT TEXT (Tag)
          # c(0, 0) explicitly targets the absolute bottom-left corner of the image device.
          plot.tag.position = c(0, 0), 
          plot.tag = element_markdown(face = "italic",
                                      hjust = 0, # Flush left
                                      vjust = 0, # Anchored to the bottom
                                      size = scale_factor * 8,
                                      lineheight = 0.4,
                                      # b=10 exactly matches the bottom plot.margin so it aligns perfectly with the caption baseline!
                                      # l=10 exactly matches the left plot.margin so it aligns vertically with your title/axes.
                                      margin = margin(b = 0, l = 10, unit = "pt")),
          
          # plot.caption.position = "plot",
          # plot.caption = element_markdown(face = "italic",
          #                                 hjust = 0,
          #                                 vjust=1,
          #                                 size = scale_factor * 8,
          #                                 lineheight=0.4,
          #                                 margin = margin(t = 5, unit = "pt")),
          
          # plot.tag.position = "plot",
          # plot.tag = element_markdown(face = "italic",
          #                             hjust = 0, # Aligned to the left edge
          #                             vjust = 1,
          #                             size = scale_factor * 8,
          #                             lineheight = 0.4,
          #                             margin = margin(t = 5, unit = "pt")),
          
          legend.position = c(0.26, 0.8),
          legend.spacing.x = unit(1, "pt"),
          legend.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "pt"),
          legend.direction="horizontal",
          legend.box.just = "left",
          legend.title = element_text(size=scale_factor*11,
                                      lineheight=0.3, hjust = 0.5),
          
          legend.text = element_text(size = scale_factor * 8,
                                     lineheight=0.3),
          
          #  legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
          axis.text = element_markdown(size= scale_factor * 10),
          strip.text.x = element_markdown(size = scale_factor * 12,
                                          lineheight = 0.3),
          
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha('white', 0)),
          
          axis.text.x = element_markdown(size= scale_factor * 10,
                                         hjust=0.5, face = "italic",
                                         margin = margin(t = 0.5, unit = "pt"),
                                         lineheight = 0.3),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

## + Fights

```{r}
# Pre-allocate a list to hold results
fights_list <- vector("list", N_REPORTS)

for(i in 1:N_REPORTS){
  
  # Download data
  WCL_response <- tryCatch(
    expr = {
      wcl_fights(
        report_code = V_REPORTS[i]
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      df_errors <<- dplyr::bind_rows(
        df_errors,
        data.frame( i         = i,
                    logID     = V_REPORTS[i],
                    # attempt   = attempts,
                    error_msg = e$message,
                    timestamp = Sys.time(),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      )
      return(e)
    }
  )
  
  
  # Check if the result was successful or an error was caught
  if (inherits(WCL_response, "error")) {
    perm_error_msg <- "Warcraft Logs GraphQL error: You do not have permission to view this report."
    
    if (grepl(perm_error_msg, WCL_response$message, fixed = TRUE)) {
      print(paste0("Permission denied for ", i_REPORT, " - skipping immediately to next report."))
      WCL_response <- NULL
      break # Exit while loop and move to next iteration of i
      
      # } else if (attempts < max_retries) {
      #   print(paste0("Other error on iteration ", i, ". Waiting 50 minutes before retrying (Attempt ", attempts, " of ", max_retries, ")..."))
      #   WCL_response <- NULL
      #   Sys.sleep(3000)
      
    } else {
      WCL_response <- NULL
    }
  } else if (!is.null(WCL_response)) {
    success <- TRUE
  }
  
  ## Save result if not null
  if (!is.null(WCL_response)) {
    fights_list[[i]] <- WCL_response
  }
  
  print(i)
  
}

df_fights <- dplyr::bind_rows(fights_list)

write_csv(df_fights,"./df_fights_P2.csv")
```

## + Players

```{r}
N_FIGHTS <- nrow(df_fights_clean)

players_list <- vector("list", N_FIGHTS)

for (i in 1:N_FIGHTS) {
  
  i_REPORT <- df_fights_clean$logID[i]
  i_FIGHT  <- df_fights_clean$fightID[i]
  
  res <- NULL
  success <- FALSE
  max_retries <- 2
  attempts <- 0
  
  while (!success && attempts < max_retries) {
    attempts <- attempts + 1
    
    res <- tryCatch(
      expr = {
        wcl_player_details(
          report_code       = i_REPORT,
          fight_id          = i_FIGHT
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        if (!exists("df_errors")) {
          df_errors <<- data.frame(
            i         = integer(),
            logID     = character(),
            fightID   = integer(),
            attempt   = integer(),
            error_msg = character(),
            timestamp = POSIXct(),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        }
        
        df_errors <<- dplyr::bind_rows(
          df_errors,
          data.frame(
            i         = i,
            logID     = i_REPORT,
            fightID   = i_FIGHT,
            attempt   = attempts,
            error_msg = e$message,
            timestamp = Sys.time(),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        )
        
        # Return the error object to check the message outside tryCatch
        return(e)
      }
    )
    
    # Check if the result was successful or an error was caught
    if (inherits(res, "error")) {
      perm_error_msg <- "Warcraft Logs GraphQL error: You do not have permission to view this report."
      
      if (grepl(perm_error_msg, res$message, fixed = TRUE)) {
        print(paste0("Permission denied for ", i_REPORT, " - skipping immediately to next report."))
        res <- NULL
        break # Exit while loop and move to next iteration of i
      } else if (attempts < max_retries) {
        print(paste0("Other error on iteration ", i, ". Waiting 50 minutes before retrying (Attempt ", attempts, " of ", max_retries, ")..."))
        res <- NULL
        Sys.sleep(3000)
      } else {
        res <- NULL
      }
    } else if (!is.null(res)) {
      success <- TRUE
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(res)) {
    players_list[[i]] <- res
  }
  
  print(paste0(i, " out of ", N_FIGHTS, " - ", i_REPORT, " ", i_FIGHT))
}

df_players <- dplyr::bind_rows(players_list)

write_csv(df_players,"./df_players_P2.csv")
# df_players <- read_csv("./df_players_P2.csv")
```

## + Hunter Events (All)

```{r}
N_FIGHTS_HUNTERS <- nrow(df_hunters)

events_hunters_list <- vector("list", N_FIGHTS_HUNTERS)

for (i in 1:N_FIGHTS_HUNTERS) {
  
  i_REPORT <- df_hunters$logID[i]
  i_FIGHT  <- df_hunters$fightID[i]
  i_STARTTIME  <- df_hunters$startTime[i]-10
  i_ENDTIME  <- df_hunters$endTime[i]+10
  i_HUNTER  <- df_hunters$actorID[i]
  
  res <- NULL
  success <- FALSE
  max_retries <- 2
  attempts <- 0
  
  while (!success && attempts < max_retries) {
    attempts <- attempts + 1
    
    res <- tryCatch(
      expr = {
        wcl_events(
          report_code       = i_REPORT,
          fight_id          = i_FIGHT,
          source_id         = i_HUNTER,
          data_type         = "All",
          hostility_type    = "Friendlies",
          # filter_expression = "ability.id = 29166",
          start_time = i_STARTTIME,
          end_time = i_ENDTIME
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        if (!exists("df_errors")) {
          df_errors <<- data.frame(
            i         = integer(),
            logID     = character(),
            fightID   = integer(),
            attempt   = integer(),
            error_msg = character(),
            timestamp = POSIXct(),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        }
        
        df_errors <<- dplyr::bind_rows(
          df_errors,
          data.frame(
            i         = i,
            logID     = i_REPORT,
            fightID   = i_FIGHT,
            attempt   = attempts,
            error_msg = e$message,
            timestamp = Sys.time(),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        )
        
        # Return the error object to check the message outside tryCatch
        return(e)
      }
    )
    
    # Check if the result was successful or an error was caught
    if (inherits(res, "error")) {
      perm_error_msg <- "Warcraft Logs GraphQL error: You do not have permission to view this report."
      
      if (grepl(perm_error_msg, res$message, fixed = TRUE)) {
        print(paste0("Permission denied for ", i_REPORT, " - skipping immediately to next report."))
        res <- NULL
        break # Exit while loop and move to next iteration of i
      } else if (attempts < max_retries) {
        print(paste0("Other error on iteration ", i, ". Waiting 40 minutes before retrying (Attempt ", attempts, " of ", max_retries, ")..."))
        res <- NULL
        Sys.sleep(2400)
      } else {
        res <- NULL
      }
    } else if (!is.null(res)) {
      success <- TRUE
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(res)) {
    events_hunters_list[[i]] <- res
  }
  
  print(paste0(i, " out of ", N_FIGHTS_HUNTERS, " - ", i_REPORT, " ", i_FIGHT))
}


df_events_hunters <- dplyr::bind_rows(events_hunters_list)

# write_csv(df_events_hunters,"./df_events_hunters.csv")
# df_events_hunters <- read_csv("./df_events_hunters.csv")
```

### - Total Weave Time

```{r}
total_weave_time <- full_join(ability_to_weave %>%
                                group_by(logID,fightID,encounterID,sourceID) %>%
                                mutate(row_number = row_number()),
                              
                              
                              weave_to_ability%>%
                                filter(indicator == 1)  %>%
                                group_by(logID,fightID,encounterID,sourceID) %>%
                                mutate(row_number = row_number()),
                              
                              
                              by=c("logID","fightID","encounterID","sourceID", "row_number") 
)%>% ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(delayms.x)) %>%
  filter(delayms.x>0) %>%
  filter(!is.na(delayms.y)) %>%
  filter(delayms.y>0) %>%
  mutate(total_delay = delayms.x + delayms.y) %>%
  filter(total_delay <=4000)
```


### - % of hunters

```{r}
df_weave_all <- df %>%
  
  dplyr::select(logID,fightID,encounterID,sourceID,duration_s) %>%
  group_by(logID,fightID,encounterID,sourceID,duration_s) %>%
  summarize(n=n()) %>% dplyr::select(-c(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  
  left_join(
    total_weave_time %>%
      group_by(logID,fightID,encounterID,sourceID) %>%
      summarize(n=n()),
    by=c("logID","fightID","encounterID","sourceID")
  ) %>%
  
  left_join(
    autoshot_bosses %>%
      dplyr::rename(autoshot = n),
    by=c("logID","fightID","encounterID","sourceID")
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(weave_n = ifelse(is.na(n),0,n)) %>%
  mutate(n_min = weave_n/(duration_s/60)) %>%
  
  mutate(weaveauthosot = weave_n/autoshot) %>%
  
  mutate(encounterID = factor(encounterID)) %>%
  mutate(weave_cat = ifelse(weaveauthosot<0.1,F,T))
# mutate(weave_cat = ifelse(n_min<1,F,T)) %>%



v_WEAVERS <- df_weave_all %>%
  # filter(weave_cat == T) %>%
  filter(weaveauthosot >= 0.1) %>%
  mutate(weaverID = paste0(logID,fightID,encounterID,sourceID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(weaverID) %>% pull(.)
```

```{r}
    #   encounterID=="Lady Vashj" ~ "Lady\nVashj",
    #   encounterID=="Kael'thas Sunstrider" ~ "Kael'thas\nSunstrider",
    #   encounterID=="Void Reaver" ~ "Void\nReaver",
    #   
    #   encounterID=="High Astromancer Solarian" ~ "High Astromancer\nSolarian",
    #   encounterID=="Fathom-Lord Karathress" ~ "Fathom-Lord\nKarathress",
    #   TRUE ~ encounterID)
    encounterName = case_when(
      encounterID==100623 ~ "<b><span style='color:#005F73;'>Hydross</span></b>",
      encounterID==100624 ~ "<b><span style='color:#005F73;'>Lurker</span></b>",
      encounterID==100625 ~ "<b><span style='color:#005F73;'>Leo</span></b>",
      encounterID==100626 ~ "<b><span style='color:#005F73;'>FLK</span></b>",
      encounterID==100627 ~ "<b><span style='color:#005F73;'>Morogrim</span></b>",
      encounterID==100628 ~ "<b><span style='color:#005F73;'>Vashj</span></b>",
      
      encounterID==100730 ~ "<b><span style='color:#990033;'>Al&#39;ar</span></b>",
      encounterID==100731 ~ "<b><span style='color:#990033;'>VR",
      encounterID==100732 ~ "<b><span style='color:#990033;'>Solarian",
      encounterID==100733 ~ "<b><span style='color:#990033;'>KT",
      
      TRUE ~ as.character(encounterID))
  ) %>%
  mutate(encounterName  = factor(encounterName,
                                 levels = c("<b><span style='color:#005F73;'>Hydross</span></b>",
                                            "<b><span style='color:#005F73;'>Lurker</span></b>",
                                            "<b><span style='color:#005F73;'>Leo</span></b>",
                                            "<b><span style='color:#005F73;'>FLK</span></b>",
                                            "<b><span style='color:#005F73;'>Morogrim</span></b>",
                                            "<b><span style='color:#005F73;'>Vashj</span></b>",
                                            
                                            "<b><span style='color:#990033;'>Al&#39;ar</span></b>",
                                            "<b><span style='color:#990033;'>VR",
                                            "<b><span style='color:#990033;'>Solarian",
                                            "<b><span style='color:#990033;'>KT"))) %>%
  
  filter(paste0(logID,fightID,encounterID,sourceID) %in% v_WEAVERS)
```

```{r}
plot_2_A <- total_weave_time %>%
  # filter(delayms.x<2000 & delayms.x>0)%>%
  # filter(delayms.y<2000 & delayms.y>0)%>%
  # filter(total_delay<5000 & total_delay>0) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(cols = c(delayms.x,delayms.y,total_delay),
               names_to = "type",values_to = "ms") %>%
  
  group_by(logID,encounterName,sourceID,type) %>%
  summarise(ms = mean(ms,na.rm=T)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  
  filter(type=="total_delay")%>%
  
  # Add encounter mean for static placement
  group_by(encounterName) %>%
  mutate(mean_ms = mean(ms, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = ms)) + 
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    aes(color = type,
        fill = type),
    adjust = .5,
    alpha=0.75,
    width = .5, 
    .width = 0,
    justification = -.05, 
    point_color = NA
  )  +
  geom_point(
    aes(y=-0.025,color = stage(type, after_scale = darken(color, .005, space = "HLS"))),
    fill = "white",
    shape = 21,
    stroke = .4,
    size = 1,
    alpha=0.15,
    position = position_jitter(seed = 1,  height = 0.05)
  ) + 
  geom_point(
    aes(y=-0.025,fill = type),
    color = "transparent",
    shape = 21,
    stroke = .4,
    size = 1,
    alpha = .005,
    position = position_jitter(seed = 1, height = 0.05)
  )+ 
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(y=-0.025,color = stage(type, after_scale = darken(color, .5, space = "HLS")),
        fill = after_scale(desaturate(lighten(color, .8), .4))),

    size = 7,
    hjust = 0.5,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  # stat_summary(fun = median, orientation = "y",
  #   geom = "text",
  #   aes(y = 0.2, x= 1700,
  #       label = round(after_stat(x)),
  #       color = stage(type, after_scale = colorspace::darken(color, 
  #                                                            .1, 
  #                                                            space = "HLS"))
  #   ),
  #   fontface = "bold",size = 4.5, 
  #   vjust = -3.5
  # )+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#3B6032"), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3B6032"), guide = "none")  +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(1000,2000,3000),
                     labels=c("1,000<br>ms","","3,000<br>ms"),
                     expand = c(0,0))+
  # annotate(
  #   x = 500, y = -0.1, 
  #   label = "500ms", geom = "text",
  #   color = "grey40",
  #   lineheight = .6,
  #   hjust = 0,
  #   size = scale_factor*2.5
  # ) + 
  # 
  labs(y=NULL,x=NULL,title= "Average Total-Weave-Time [Ability-to-Weave + Weave-to-Ability]")+
```

### - Plot % hunters


```{r}
plot <- df_weave_all%>%
  # 1. Calculate the percentage of the target category per encounter
  group_by(encounterName) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = mean(as.logical(weave_cat), na.rm = TRUE) 
  ) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x=encounterName,fill=weave_cat),
           position="fill")+ 
  
  # Text layer placed above the 100% bar (y = 1.03)
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = encounterName, 
      y = 1.01, 
      label = scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1) # Formats to e.g., "18.2%"
    ),
    stat = "unique", # Prevents overlapping duplicate text per row
    size = 10,
    color = "#92BA5A",
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = 0
  ) + 
  
  geom_vline(xintercept=6.5)+ 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.5, linetype="dashed",size=0.25) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.25, linetype="dotted",size=0.25) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.75, linetype="dotted",size=0.25) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values =c("grey75","#AAD372"),, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, 
                     limits = c(0,1.08),
                     breaks = seq(0,1,by=0.25),
                     expand = c(0,0)) +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title= "% of Hunters Melee Weaving (No deaths, ≥10% Weave-to-AutoShot Ratio, and <4000 ms Total-Weave-Time)",
    subtitle = NULL,
    
    tag = paste0(
      "<span style='font-family:forgefooter'>&#xe900;</span> &nbsp; discord.gg/wp55kqmyYG\u00A0&bull; &nbsp;Discfordge &#91;Vivax-Pagle(US)&#93;<br>",

  vivax_theme() +
  theme(  plot.title = element_markdown(color="grey40",
                                        face ="italic" ,size = scale_factor * 9,
                                        hjust = 0,
                                        margin = margin(b = 1)),
```
